Sandbox_PZSorter_SorterRange_tooltip: How far a Sorter Crate reaches, in tiles. The area is a square: this many tiles in any direction, including diagonally, on the crate's floor and one floor above and one floor below.
Sandbox_PZSorter_SortSpeed_tooltip: Realistic plays a timed action. About 50 items takes about 10 seconds, and heavy loot takes longer. Instant sorts as soon as you press Sort.
